unprofiled_timing_control.scope: unprofiled Metal command GPU timestamps; alternating mode order

interpretation: Replay profiles describe the captured Metal workload under the recorded settings, not original application wall time.
Native limiter percentages overlap; no GPU pipeline-slot partition is derived.
Values above 100 percent are preserved and flagged, with their M6 denominator unvalidated.
The memory controls do not establish a calibrated DRAM-bound classification.
Native core sampling coverage varies; comparisons must account for the reported coverage.
Raw .trace/.gputrace captures and system-wide counter exports remain local.

cli_record.workflow: apple gpu record --store; apple query --section encoders; apple gpu report --run-id

installed_wheel.workflow: installed wheel, outside checkout: apple gpu profile --execution serial --store
